title: ECB block-cipher mode (MODE_ECB) — review required
description: ECB mode encrypts each block independently, so identical plaintext blocks produce identical ciphertext blocks and data patterns leak through encryption. ECB is never the right default. This lexical rule flags the mode constant; the reviewer replaces it with an authenticated mode.
remediation: Use an authenticated mode such as GCM (or ChaCha20-Poly1305) with a unique nonce per message, via a high-level library. Never select ECB, even for single-block data.
limitation: Lexical: matches the MODE_ECB constant only; ECB selected through other spellings or libraries is missed, and nonce discipline for the replacement is out of scope.
